summary: Sporting News previews the Week 14 Thursday Night Football game between the Patriots and Steelers, offering FanDuel and SuperDraft DFS lineups for single-game tournaments. The author expects a low-scoring, defense-driven game with backup-caliber quarterbacks, so the picks lean on running backs, defenses and kickers. Scoring rules and lineup structures for both platforms are explained.
one_line: Nick Brinkerhoff's Week 14 TNF DFS guide for Patriots-Steelers recommends running backs, defenses and kickers on FanDuel and SuperDraft for a low-scoring game.
key_facts: The FanDuel lineup has a $60,000 budget and requires at least one player from each team.
FanDuel scoring uses four-point passing TDs and half-point PPR.
The MVP (1.5x points) pick is Patriots RB Ezekiel Elliott at $12,000, who starts because Rhamondre Stevenson (ankle) is sidelined for the foreseeable future.
Steelers RB Najee Harris ($14,000) is a FLEX pick, averaging 15 carries per game over the past five games and scoring in three of them as the preferred goal-line back.
The Steelers D/ST ($10,000) faces a Patriots offense that has scored 13 points in the past three weeks.
The Patriots D/ST ($9,000) is picked because New England has not allowed more than 10 points in three straight weeks.
Steelers kicker Chris Boswell ($8,500) is the FLEX K, citing last week's 6-0 Chargers win in New England with two field goals.
The game features Mitch Trubisky against Bailey Zappe, a matchup the article calls potentially the worst Thursday night game of the season.
SuperDraft scoring uses half-point PPR, four-point passing TDs, and two-point bonuses for 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards and 300 passing yards.
SuperDraft Champion (+50% points) is Najee Harris at a 1.9x multiplier; Co-Champ (+25% points) is Ezekiel Elliott at 1.4x.
SuperDraft Super FLEX picks are Mitch Trubisky (1.15x), Pat Freiermuth (1.35x), Chris Boswell (1.8x) and Patriots kicker Chad Ryland (1.8x).
The SuperDraft lineup pairs a Trubisky-Freiermuth stack with both kickers and the two running backs.
SuperDraft offers a free $10 deposit with promo code "TSN".
